title: Superposition
summary: SUPERPOSI'TION, noun [super and position.] 1. A placing above; a lying or being situated above or upon something; as the superposition of rocks. 2. That which is situated above or upon something else.

inlines.v: SUPERPOSI'TION, noun [super and position.] 1. A placing above; a lying or being situated above or upon something; as the superposition of rocks. 2. That which is situated above or upon something else.
